sources.use: The behaviour specification this package implements. Nothing upstream was opened, decompiled or read to write this package.

The rights record the specification was written under, which clears code and behaviour and leaves names unresolved. The constraint bites in three places for this entry and this package answers each: the three registered ingredient-kind names and the seven category-type names are coined in this package's own namespace, which section four licenses for a counterpart that need not be save-compatible, so aliases.json is empty; and the item form's count-escape field name is a compatibility requirement, so it is read from a build-time input with a placeholder the tests pin the surrounding format with.

Section ten of that entry describes the interface vocabulary this entry compiles against, which the wave decided RVL-210's counterpart owns. It was read to know what this package consumes and must not redeclare.

The interface vocabulary: the ingredient-kind abstraction, the match-condition set, the quantity type, the kind refusal, the slot-addressed and slotless storage abstractions with their attempt and slot results, and the capability-constructor registry every attachment is declared through. None of these is redeclared here.

The whole of what this package names of Ravel's own surface: the mod lifecycle, content declaration, configuration declaration and resolution, the game-event stream and the value type a stored form is written in.
